title: The Shattered Crown
premise: An ancient crown has fractured, and rival powers race to gather its pieces.

acts.name: Act I: The Broken Road
acts.objective: Find the first heirloom and learn who broke the crown.
dialogue: The road has gone quiet since the crown vanished.
Each shard carries a memory the realms would rather forget.

quests.name: The Missing Heirloom
quests.description: Recover the first clue to the missing crown.

events.name: A Road of Ash
events.text: A black feather is pinned beneath a broken royal sign.
